verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The first clause is definitional in Lean and matches exactly: both OscillatoryCurl.wave and the constructed PhysicalSignedWave…physicalVelocity are *defined* as SpatialCurl.spatialCurl of a vector potential, and SpatialCurl.curl/curlLinear is the ordinary antisymmetric Jacobian on Euclidean ℝ³, with the physical time held fixed. The second clause is proved rather than assumed, but with hypotheses the paper leaves tacit: SpatialCurl.spatialDivergence_spatialCurl needs the potential C² on the spatial slice at the point; OscillatoryCurl.wave_divergence_free adds smoothness of the phase and amplitude on an open set and a non-vanishing phase normal there; PhysicalSignedWave…physicalVelocity_divergence (I read its full hypothesis list at PhysicalSignedWave.lean:1231-1240) adds the band's regularity and angular-periodicity data R and A, a non-zero reference frequency hK, a ChartGeometry G, hradius (every point of the strip domain has positive radius), a positive radius at the point (0 < z.2 0), membership of the graph image in the strip domain (hx), 0 < delta, and membership in a valid cylindrical chart (hchart). Those are the standing smoothness and off-axis assumptions of the construction, not extra mathematical content, so the display is recovered wherever the paper's objects are defined. A separate algebraic cylindrical version, CurlGeometry.cylindrical_div_curl, proves div(curl A) = 0 for the 1/r-corrected cylindrical operators under stated commutation and product rules.
